item.title: Bangladesh elected Vice Chair of UN Peacebuilding Commission for 2026
item.description: Bangladesh has been elected as the Vice-Chair of the UN Peacebuilding Commission (PBC) for the year 2026.The election of the five-member bureau of the PBC was held at the UN Headquarters in New York on Thursday.The members of the Commission during its first meeting of the 20th session elected Morrocco as Chair while Germany, Brazil and Croatia and Bangladesh were elected as Vice-Chairs.The Peacebuilding Commission is an intergovernmental advisory body that supports peace efforts in conflict-affe

item.title: Unhealthy air grips Dhaka, ranks second globally

item.title: Ctg Port overloaded as pre-Ramadan imports hit record levels
item.description: Around 2.3 million tonnes of essential commodities remain stuck on 46 ships at Chattogram Port’s outer anchorage, as a surge in pre-Ramadan imports has put severe pressure on the country’s supply chain, causing delays in unloading.Port officials said imports of essentials have surpassed all previous records this year, overwhelming the system from large mother vessels to factories and warehouses.The situation has been exacerbated by an acute shortage of lighter vessels used for inland river trans

item.title: Gold price drops by Tk 14,000 per bhori
item.description: After five consecutive hikes, gold prices in the domestic market have finally been reduced, with the Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) announcing a cut of up to Tk 14,600 per bhori.As a result, the price of top-grade gold has fallen to Tk 271,000 per bhori. item.title: Fire breaks out in parked bus in Uttara
item.description: A fire broke out in a parked bus at House Building area of Uttara in the capital on Friday morning.The incident occurred around 9:30 AM on Friday (January 30), when a bus belonging to Bhuiyan Paribahan caught fire while parked. item.title: Tarique Rahman set to campaign in Rangpur today
item.description: BNP Chairperson Tarique Rahman is scheduled to visit Rangpur on Friday (30 January) as part of his election campaign ahead of the 13th National Parliamentary Election.Party sources said Tarique Rahman will arrive in Pirganj at around 3:45 PM, where he will pay homage at the grave of Abu Sayeed, who was killed during the 2024 student–public mass uprising. item.title: Bogura stands as model for planned national development: Tarique Rahman

item.title: RAB re-arrests 3 murder suspects mistakenly freed from M’singh jail
item.description: Rapid Action Battalion (RAB-14) has arrested three murder case suspects on Thursday night, who were inadvertently released from Mymensingh Central Jail without bail.The arrested were identified as Md Anis Mia, Rashedul Islam and Zakirul Islam, residents of Tarati village under Tarakanda Police Station area in Mymensingh district.According to sources, the trio had been mistakenly released from Mymensingh Central Jail on Tuesday evening, despite no official bail orders being issued. item.title: Missing man’s body recovered in Narsingdi
item.description: The body of a missing man was recovered from a pond in Nager Bazar area of Belabo upazila on Thursday night, three days after he went missing.The deceased was identified as Azimul Qader Bhuiya, 45, a resident of Raghab village of Bajnabaup union of the upazila. item.title: 50th BCS preliminary exam held
item.description: The preliminary stage of the 50th Bangladesh Civil Service (BCS) examination held on Friday, with tests began at 10:00 AM simultaneously in 190 centres across Dhaka and seven other divisional cities.According to the Bangladesh Public Service Commission (PSC), a total of 290,952 candidates applied for the exam.
